name: open_colab_browser_connection
description: Opens a connection to a Google Colab browser session and unlocks notebook editing tools. Returns a boolean representing whether the connection attempt succeeded

name: add_code_cell
description: Inserts a code type cell at the provided index and shifts existing cells. The resulting new cell id is returned.

cellIndex.description: The index at which to insert the cell.

language.description: The programming language of the new cell.

code.description: The code content of the new cell.

name: add_text_cell
description: Inserts a text type cell at the provided index and shifts existing cells. The resulting new cell id is returned.

cellIndex.description: The index at which to insert the cell.

content.description: The content of the new cell. This can include Markdown and LaTeX syntax.

name: delete_cell
description: Deletes the cell with the provided cell ID.

cellId.description: The ID of the cell to delete.

name: get_cells
description: Gets a range of cells as JSON from the notebook.

cellIndexStart.description: The starting index for the cell range (inclusive). If not provided, this defaults to 0.

cellIndexEnd.description: The end index for the cell range (inclusive). This must be greater than or equal to cellIndexStart. If not provided, this defaults to the last available cell index.

includeOutputs.description: Whether to include the code cell execution outputs in the response. If not provided, this defaults to false.

name: move_cell
description: Moves a cell to the provided index and shifts existing cells.

cellId.description: The ID of the cell to move.

cellIndex.description: The index to move the cell to.

name: run_code_cell
description: Executes the code in the cell with the provided cell ID. The cell must be acode cell type. The output of the cell execution is returned.

cellId.description: The ID of the code cell to execute.

name: update_cell
description: Overwrites the contents of the cell with the provided new content. The cell must already exist and is identified by its cell ID.

cellId.description: The ID of the cell to update.

content.description: The new content of the cell.
